title: Business Analyst
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Business Analyst who wants to learn and transform his career.

Responsabilities

  • Own translation of user needs into detailed, ready-to-build requirements for the squad.
  • Define and document benefit hypotheses and testable acceptance criteria for backlog features.
  • Write clear, unambiguous user stories and acceptance criteria using BDD/Gherkin, user-centric principles and INVEST.
  • Use quantitative data to influence product decisions and operationalize PO-approved plans.
  • Partner with the PO to ensure backlog alignment with business priorities (PO retains final prioritization, scope changes and release sign-off).
  • Keep work 2–3 sprints ahead of the squad; ensure each feature meets DoR and DoD and is sprint-ready.
  • Partner with the Scrum Master to assess team capacity, participate in rituals, and help define DoR/DoD.
  • Facilitate and lead refinement sessions with the squad.
  • Map and manage interdependencies across products and teams; coordinate with PO and Product Manager.
  • Identify key unknowns, propose alternatives, and manage spikes within sprints to reduce risk.
  • Communicate product vision and functional intent to developers and testers; drive improvements to user experience.
  • Communicate risks and impediments; support trade-offs and ROAM-based decision making with the PO.
  • Document confirmed business processes as authoritative references for stakeholders (end users, development, IT support).
  • Identify process bottlenecks and collaborate with PO, SM, QA/TQ and the squad to mitigate them.
  • Support and/or facilitate system demos (inspect-and-adapt) as needed.
  • Support UAT activities as required (write scripts and/or guide business users on test execution), depending on the product.

Skills Required.

  • 5+ years’ experience as a Product Analyst.
  • Proven knowledge of product and industry best practices.
  • Strong technical written and verbal English; comfortable with technical documentation.
  • Strong problem-solving and judgment; solid understanding of customer journeys and customer experience.
  • Intermediate SQL for ad-hoc queries and data analysis.
  • Experience managing product backlogs and release plans; tracking team metrics and removing blockers.
  • Proficient with Agile frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) and tools (JIRA, Confluence).
  • Data Modeling & Architecture: Data warehousing, Data lakes, Data pipelines.
  • Deep understanding of business processes and high-quality digital product delivery.
  • Demonstrated leadership influencing cross-functional, self-organizing teams.
  • Comfortable working in complex, diverse and fast-changing environments; adapts quickly to evolving priorities.
  • Able to deliver high-quality work during uncertainty and ambiguity.
  • Advocates and fosters a data-driven culture focused on measurable outcomes and business agility.
  • Willingness to challenge assumptions and contribute constructive, innovative ideas.
  • Nice to have: IIBA (business analysis) or PSPO/CSPO (Product Owner) certifications — PSPO/CSPO useful if the candidate may act as an ad-hoc deputy PO.

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

  • Health insurance
  • Dental Plan
  • Life insurance
  • Transportation vouchers
  • Meal/Food Voucher
  • Childcare assistance
  • Gympass
  • TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates
  • Partnership with SESC
  • Reimbursement of Certifications
  • Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training
  • International experience opportunity
  • Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools
  • TCS Gems – Recognition for performance
  • Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Senior Business Analyst
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a data-driven Business Performance Analyst to join the Keeta Brazil User Growth team in São Paulo. You will support business target tracking and performance monitoring, diagnose key metric anomalies, conduct deep-dive analyses on growth-related topics, and build reusable analytical assets to drive efficiency and scalability.

Responsibilities

1. Support business target tracking and performance monitoring; regularly deliver business review reports to management

2. Identify and diagnose anomalies in key business metrics, conduct root-cause analysis from multiple perspectives, and provide actionable optimization recommendations

3. Participate in or lead deep-dive analytical projects on critical business topics, including user growth, subsidy efficiency, and campaign effectiveness

4. Build and maintain reusable analytical assets — for high-frequency, mission-critical analysis workflows, develop standardized tools, templates, and automated solutions

Requirements

1. Proficient in SQL (Hive/Spark SQL preferred), able to independently write complex queries for large-scale data extraction and analysis

2. Working proficiency in English

3. Strong analytical thinking: ability to structure ambiguous problems, identify patterns, and translate data into business insights

4. Excellent communication skills — able to present findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

5. Open mindset for working in a cross-cultural team

6. Sharp and fast learner — able to quickly ramp up on new business domains and analytical frameworks

Nice-to-Have

• Experience in data analysis at internet/e-commerce/on-demand delivery platforms (food delivery, ride-hailing, marketplace, etc.), or consulting industry experience

• Experience in business performance monitoring or operational analytics

• Experience with A/B testing and causal inference methodologies

• Familiarity with user segmentation, lifecycle analysis, or subsidy/promotion analysis

• Experience working in cross-cultural, globally distributed teams

Keeta Brazil is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities (PwD). If you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know - we are here to support you.

title: Pessoa Especialista BP | Operações Varejo
description:
#NossoJeitoDeSer

Aqui no Grupo Carrefour Brasil vivemos o #NossoJeitoDeSer todos os dias. O Cliente está no centro da Excelência em tudo o que fazemos, e é ele quem guia nossas decisões e inspira nossas entregas. Atuamos com Coragem para simplificar e Fazer acontecer, buscando soluções simples, eficientes e sustentáveis que gerem impacto real.

Nosso trabalho é construído tendo como base Compromisso com o Resultado, e com foco em Cooperar, Desenvolver e Formar nosso Time, pois sabemos que quando uma pessoa cresce, ela leva outras consigo.

E cultivamos um ambiente de Inclusão e Orgulho em Pertencer à Família, onde todas as pessoas são respeitadas, valorizadas e incentivadas a serem quem realmente são.

Se identificou com a nossa cultura e nossos valores? Então vem fazer parte do nosso time!

Sobre a área:

A área de HRBP atua como parceira estratégica das lideranças, conectando a estratégia de Pessoas aos desafios do negócio e apoiando diretamente as Operações do Varejo.

O time atua de forma próxima às lideranças, compreendendo a operação, seus indicadores e prioridades para transformar dados e necessidades do negócio em ações e soluções estratégicas que contribuam para performance, eficiência e sustentabilidade dos resultados.

Entre os principais temas de atuação estão estrutura, performance, talentos, cultura, engajamento e desenvolvimento, fortalecendo a agenda de Pessoas como uma alavanca para os resultados do Grupo.

Desafios dessa posição:

  • Atuar como parceiro estratégico das Operações Carrefour – Hiper e Super, conectando a agenda de Pessoas às prioridades e desafios do negócio;
  • Acompanhar e analisar indicadores de Pessoas e do Negócio, identificando tendências, desvios, riscos e oportunidades e transformando dados em insights e recomendações para apoiar a tomada de decisão;
  • Conduzir diagnósticos e análises relacionados a estrutura organizacional, workforce, produtividade e eficiência, propondo soluções com impacto mensurável;
  • Apoiar as lideranças nos ciclos de performance, talentos, sucessão e desenvolvimento, garantindo a qualidade das discussões e a efetividade dos planos de ação;
  • Liderar e acompanhar projetos e agendas estratégicas de RH, garantindo execução, governança e evolução dos resultados;
  • Apoiar as lideranças em movimentações, desenho organizacional e decisões relacionadas à workforce, considerando estratégia, eficiência e sustentabilidade;
  • Atuar de forma integrada com os Centros de Expertise (COEs), conectando as necessidades do negócio às políticas, processos e soluções de RH;
  • Construir análises, materiais e recomendações executivas para fóruns de liderança e tomada de decisão;
  • Identificar e antecipar riscos e oportunidades de Pessoas, propondo ações preventivas e apoiando decisões mais ágeis e assertivas;
  • Contribuir para o fortalecimento da cultura, conectando as iniciativas corporativas à realidade das lojas e das operações;
  • Promover uma atuação de RH cada vez mais estratégica, orientada a dados e à geração de valor para o negócio.

Você precisa ter:

Ensino Superior Completo;

Disponibilidade para viagens;

Conhecimentos em Excel, PowerPoint (construção de apresentações executivas);

Experiência como HRBP.

Adoraríamos se você tiver:

Conhecimento em ferramentas de automação, integração e gestão de dados, como Power Query, Looker Studio, Power Automate e Power BI;

Experiência de atuação no segmento de Varejo.

title: Analista de Crédito Junior
description:
Na Sherwin-Williams, nós colorimos o mundo! Com mais de 85 anos de história no Brasil e fazendo parte de uma marca global com mais de 150 anos, somos líderes na indústria de tintas e revestimentos, reconhecidos por nossa inovação, qualidade e compromisso com a sustentabilidade.

Estamos em busca de um Analista de Crédito Júnior, para a região de São Bernardo do Campo, para atuar no suporte às atividades relacionadas à gestão de crédito, cobrança e recebíveis da companhia, realizando análises, controles e acompanhamento de clientes, em conformidade com as políticas e procedimentos da área, contribuindo para a mitigação de riscos e para os resultados da companhia.

Requisitos

  • Experiência de até 2 anos em atividades de crédito, cobrança, contas a receber ou áreas financeiras correlatas.
  • Desejável vivência em rotinas administrativas e financeiras, além de relacionamento com clientes internos e externos.
  • Boa comunicação, organização, atenção aos detalhes e capacidade analítica.
  • Desejável conhecimento em sistemas ERP, preferencialmente Oracle ou similares.
  • Português fluente e conhecimento básico de inglês será considerado diferencial.
  • Conhecimentos em análise de crédito, demonstrações financeiras, fluxo de caixa e indicadores financeiros.
  • Conhecimento de pacote Microsoft Office, com ênfase em Excel avançado para elaboração e manutenção de relatórios e controles.
  • Desejável conhecimento em Power-Point e Power BI

Formação acadêmica

  • Curso Superior Completo, preferencialmente em Administração de Empresas, Economia (Ou similares)
  • Pós – Graduação em Administração ou em outras áreas correlatas (Desejável)

Responsabilidades

  • Apoiar a área comercial na análise cadastral e na coleta de informações econômico-financeiras necessárias para avaliação de crédito de clientes.
  • Executar análises de crédito para concessão, renovação e manutenção de limites de crédito, seguindo as políticas, normas e diretrizes estabelecidas pela companhia.
  • Realizar consultas em bureaus de crédito e outras fontes de informação, apoiando a avaliação da situação econômico-financeira e do comportamento de pagamento dos clientes.

title: Head of Business Development Americas
description:
About the opportunity

A multinational energy group is seeking a senior executive to lead its Business Development strategy and support the continued growth of its operations in Americas.

This is a highly visible leadership position for an executive with extensive experience in the Americas power sector, strong commercial and institutional relationships, and a proven ability to originate, structure and develop complex energy and infrastructure projects.

The executive will play a central role in defining the company’s growth strategy, identifying new opportunities and building long-term relationships with clients, partners, investors, financial institutions, regulatory authorities and other relevant stakeholders.

The position involves close interaction with the company’s global executive leadership and cross-functional teams throughout the entire project value chain.

Key responsibilities

  • Define and execute the Business Development strategy for Americas, aligned with the company’s global objectives.
  • Originate and evaluate new renewable energy and infrastructure opportunities, including greenfield developments, partnerships and potential acquisitions.
  • Identify prospective clients and offtakers and support the origination and negotiation of Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs).
  • Monitor power market, regulatory environment, economic trends and evolving customer needs.
  • Develop and maintain senior-level relationships with authorities, regulatory agencies, industry associations, clients, partners, investors, lenders and other strategic stakeholders.
  • Lead project development activities, including opportunity assessment, commercial structuring, bid preparation, negotiations and investment decision processes.
  • Coordinate multidisciplinary teams.
  • Assess commercial, regulatory, technical and financial risks and ensure they are appropriately reflected in business cases and financial models.
  • Support project acquisitions, strategic partnerships, tender processes and other growth initiatives.
  • Represent the company in relevant business forums, institutional meetings and industry events.
  • Provide leadership, direction and development to the team, promoting collaboration and effective execution.

Qualifications and experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Economics, Business Administration, Finance, Law or another relevant field.
  • At least 15 years of professional experience, including significant experience in executive or senior leadership positions.
  • Strong track record in Business Development within the energy or infrastructure sectors.
  • Experience working in multinational companies and complex matrix organizations.
  • English and Spanish are required.
  • Availability for business travel.

Leadership profile

We are looking for an entrepreneurial and commercially minded executive who combines strategic perspective with the ability to deliver results.

  • Strong business judgment and ability to identify value-creating opportunities.
  • Executive presence and credibility with senior internal and external stakeholders.
  • Excellent negotiation, communication and influencing skills.
  • Ability to navigate complex commercial and institutional environments.
  • Collaborative leadership across functions, cultures and geographies.
  • Strong governance, integrity and risk-management orientation.
  • Ability to build teams, develop talent and lead through change.
  • Independence, adaptability and a hands-on approach when required.

Why join?

The successful candidate will operate with broad exposure to global leadership and will have the opportunity to shape the company’s long-term positioning and expansion in America´s market.

This recruitment process is being conducted on a confidential basis. Additional information about the company and the position will be shared with selected candidates during the process.

We welcome applications from qualified professionals of all backgrounds and are committed to an inclusive and diverse selection process.

title: Sr Finance Analyst
description:
Chery is a leading Chinese automotive company with a diverse portfolio that includes the R&D, production, and sales of passenger cars, commercial vehicles, mini cars, specialty vehicles, and powertrain systems. With over 8.75 million vehicles sold globally, Chery serves customers in more than 80 countries and regions worldwide .

Omoda & Jaecoo is an innovative new brand under the Chery Group, operating independently from other Chery brands. It focuses on cutting-edge design and technology in the production and sales of passenger vehicle s.

We are looking for people who, like us, are innovative, practical, objective, have a passion for what they do and aim for excellence.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Support for Sales Operations

  • Connect with new vehicle, used vehicle, spare parts and accessories, after-sales maintenance, etc., communicate fully with the dealer team, and provide full-process sales side financial support.
  • Communicate and coordinate on the financial compliance and profit calculations of sales programs such as business policies, promotional policies, rebate programs, dealer cooperation terms, and installment/financial leasing
  • Tracking of inbound and outbound of vehicles and spare parts, as well as quarterly and annual inventory counts

Accounts Receivable & Floorplan Repayment & Financial Risk Control

  • Manage the increase of dealer Floorplan credit limit and monitor the daily credit limit
  • Reconciliation of accounts with dealers and financial institutions, follow-up on overdue debt collection and aging analysis of accounts
  • Connect with Brazilian automotive finance and insurance partners, calculate and settle monthly dealer rebates, financial rebates, insurance commissions, and interest subsidy expenses for accounting entry

Budget Analysis and Expense Control

  • Prepare the annual budget and monthly rolling forecast for the sales module
  • Manage marketing department expenses, and regularly conduct budget execution and variance analysis
  • Output sales dimension data daily/weekly/monthly: wholesale sales volume, actual sales volume, identify loss-making models, inefficient stores, etc.

Process Optimization and XFN Communication

  • In combination with business scenarios, standardize the financial nodes of the entire automotive sales process: optimize internal control processes such as vehicle reservation, invoicing, vehicle delivery, refund, vehicle return and exchange, and test drive vehicle circulation
  • Collaborate with internal audit, tax inspection, and manufacturer audit in preparing materials, and coordinate with after-sales, procurement, human resources, and administration to implement compliance requirements

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree majoring in accounting, finance, taxation, economics, management or related fields
  • Advanced English skills
  • More than 2 years of work experience, with experience in the automotive dealership/4S store/complete vehicle sales/automotive retail industry preferred
  • Familiar with automotive sales business models: new car retail, used cars, after-sales maintenance, financial installment plans, dealer rebates, and manufacturer policy settlement
  • Proficient in using Excel and SAP systems for sales data analysis, expense control, and accounts receivable period management, with strong data sensitivity

Location and work-model:

100% on-site (Rochaverá building - near Shopping Morumbi).

title: Remote Commercial Lawyer - Brazil
description:
About Moritz

Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.

We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.

We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.

Moritz has raised a $9M seed round from Y Combinator, 20VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.

The Role

  • Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's commercial and procurement legal work in Brazil: master services agreements, supply and distribution agreements, framework agreements, partnership and reseller contracts, and public procurement matters.
  • Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of commercial contracts for clients ranging from startups to midsize and enterprise companies — on both the buy side and the sell side.
  • Advise clients on public procurement: tender preparation and review, bid compliance, framework agreements, contract award procedures, and challenge / remedies processes.
  • Draft and negotiate SLAs, pricing and payment schedules, liability and indemnity frameworks, warranties, and termination provisions.
  • If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years practising commercial or procurement law in private practice or in-house.
  • Deep familiarity with commercial contracting — services, supply, distribution, licensing, liability, indemnities, and termination.
  • Public procurement grounding. Experience with public tender processes and procurement regulation (EU procurement directives or local equivalents), ideally from both the bidder and contracting-authority perspective.
  • Strong negotiation instincts. You know which points move the deal and which are noise.
  • Commercial fluency. You can read a pricing model, understand the business behind the contract, and ask the right questions.
  • Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.

Why Moritz

  • Work at the sharp end of high-volume commercial contracting — with AI tooling that removes the drudgery, not the judgment.
  • Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice.
  • Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity.
  • Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.

Frequently Asked Questions

How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?

Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.

What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?

Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.

Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?

No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.

How are co-counsel matched to client matters?

Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

title: Testador de clubes de poker ao vivo
description:
Você entra nos clubes de poker como um jogador comum, joga cash e torneios, e por dentro avalia tudo o que importa: as condições de jogo, a integridade, a segurança e o atendimento. O que você reporta vira base pra decisão.

No dia a dia

Você visita os clubes presencialmente e joga como qualquer cliente, sem ninguém saber que está ali pra testar. Enquanto joga, avalia as condições de jogo: limites, estruturas de torneio, rake e taxas, cap, a qualidade das mesas, das fichas e das cartas. Observa o trabalho dos dealers e a integridade do jogo, do embaralhamento e da distribuição até os erros de mesa e as decisões do floor em disputas.

Olha a parte de segurança com atenção: controle na entrada, operação do caixa, manuseio de dinheiro, câmeras e a segurança dos jogadores no geral. Testa o processo de cash-in e cash-out, reparando na velocidade, nos limites, na transparência e nas filas ou lista de espera. Também sente o ambiente: recepção, equipe, comida e bebida, limpeza, o clima do lugar. E confere se o clube é legítimo e se entrega o que anuncia.

Depois de cada visita, tudo isso vira um relatório de campo estruturado, com fotos e vídeos onde for permitido, seguindo sempre os mesmos critérios pra dar pra comparar um clube com o outro.

O que você precisa

Conhecimento sólido de poker ao vivo, das regras à etiqueta e ao fluxo do jogo, pra jogar de forma convincente e perceber as nuances que passam despercebidas. Disponibilidade pra rodar entre locais, dentro da cidade, na região ou em viagem. Boa capacidade de observação e memória pros detalhes. Discrição, porque o trabalho é disfarçado e ninguém pode saber que você é testador. Conseguir escrever relatórios claros e organizados. E tranquilidade pra lidar com dinheiro e bankroll real na mesa.

Conta ponto

Experiência como jogador ao vivo, seja reg ou profissional. Conhecer a cena local de poker e dos clubes. Inglês. Habilidade pra registrar bem em foto e vídeo.

Como funciona

Formato: trabalho de campo com viagens. Custos cobertos: buy-ins, bankroll, deslocamento e hospedagem

title: Assistente Social
description:
Assistente Social

Sobre a Empresa

O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos. Desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

Sobre a Função

Prestar suporte ao bem-estar dos colaboradores e suas famílias, atuando de forma preventiva e assistencial para melhorar a qualidade de vida e a integração social no ambiente de trabalho, desenvolvendo ações voltadas para a saúde, inclusão, direitos sociais e suporte em situações pessoais ou laborais que impactam os colaboradores.

Responsabilidades

  • Orientar, encaminhar e acompanhar casos de afastamentos pelo INSS (por saúde, acidentes, doenças ocupacionais ou não), garantindo suporte ao colaborador durante o período de afastamento e auxiliando no retorno ao trabalho;
  • Prestar atendimento ao colaborador ou familiar quanto ao pedido de indenização de sinistro do Plano de Seguro de Vida em Grupo da Empresa;
  • Emitir parecer técnico sobre situação social apresentada por funcionário ou de interação funcional visando ações de melhoria na qualidade de vida no trabalho e no clima organizacional;
  • Realizar atendimentos/visitas aos colaboradores, ouvindo demandas relacionadas a problemas sociais, familiares, econômicos, saúde e/ou afastamento do trabalho, prestando apoio em situações de vulnerabilidade social, como endividamento, doenças crônicas, dependência química, violência doméstica e outras questões pessoais;
  • Acompanhar empresas terceiras quando de acidentes de trabalho, orientando quanto das providências necessárias;
  • Orientar colaboradores sobre seus direitos trabalhistas e previdenciários, como licença-maternidade, auxílio-doença, aposentadoria e benefícios;
  • Desenvolver e implementar campanhas temáticas, como: prevenção ao uso de álcool e drogas, educação financeira (combate ao endividamento), valorização da saúde mental e combate ao estresse e ao burnout, prevenção à violência doméstica e proteção aos direitos da mulher;
  • Desenvolver ações que garantam a inclusão de grupos minoritários, como pessoas com deficiência (PcD), pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade ou jovens aprendizes;
  • Mediar conflitos no ambiente de trabalho, colaborando com o setor de Gestão de Pessoas para manter relações saudáveis entre colaboradores e setores;
  • Oferecer suporte em situações de assédio moral, dificuldades de adaptação ao ambiente de trabalho ou problemas intersetoriais;
  • Apoiar à área de Gestão de Pessoas na implementação e gestão de benefícios sociais, como: auxílio-creche, auxílio filho com deficiência, auxílio moradia, assistência médica e farmacêutica entre outros;
  • Realizar ações de integração social, explicando as políticas de qualidade de vida, saúde e bem-estar oferecidas pela Arauco;
  • Atuar junto a colaboradores e familiares com dificuldades de adaptação à região, problemas familiares ou psicológicos, assegurando apoio e encaminhamento adequado;
  • Elaborar relatórios sobre atendimentos realizados, ações desenvolvidas e resultados alcançados;
  • Acompanhar e reportar dados sobre absenteísmo, afastamentos por problemas sociais e adesão aos programas oferecidos;
  • Identificar oportunidades de novas políticas e ações voltadas ao bem-estar dos colaboradores e à responsabilidade social;

Local de atuação

  • Inocência/ MS

Requisitos

  • Graduação em Serviço Social;
  • Microsoft Excel e demais ferramentas do Microsoft Office intermediário;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas da Qualidade;
  • Conhecimento da legislação trabalhista e previdenciária;
  • Familiaridade com programas de políticas públicas sociais e redes de apoio governamentais;
  • Conhecimento em programas de responsabilidade social corporativa e qualidade de vida no trabalho;
  • Experiência com elaboração de relatórios sociais e indicadores de atendimento;
  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Serviço Social (CRESS).

Diferenciais

  • Atuação em fábrica de celulose e/ou papel;
  • Conhecimento de Espanhol.

title: Regional Sales Manager
description:
The Regional Sales Manager is responsible for developing and executing ND Paper's sales strategy within the assigned territory of São Paulo, Brazil. This role is focused on driving profitable growth by expanding market share, acquiring new customers, strengthening strategic customer relationships, and growing ND Paper's direct sales business.

The Regional Sales Manager is accountable for achieving assigned sales and revenue targets while leading regional sales initiatives, developing high-performing customer relationships, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to support the long-term success of ND Paper throughout South America.

Location: São Paulo, Brazil

Work Arrangement: Onsite (Local Office)

Key Responsibilities:

  • Achieve assigned sales volume, revenue, and profitability targets.
  • Identify, develop, and secure new customers while expanding ND Paper's direct sales business within the assigned region.
  • Develop and manage strategic customer accounts to increase customer retention, market share, and long-term business growth.
  • Monitor gross margin performance and implement strategies to maximize profitability.
  • Gather competitor intelligence, monitor local market pricing trends, prepare accurate sales forecasts, and execute regional sales and promotional initiatives.
  • Collaborate with Production, Logistics, Sales, and After-Sales teams to ensure timely deliveries, resolve customer claims, manage port detention and overdue balances, and deliver exceptional customer service.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers, distributors, and business partners.
  • Support the development and performance of the regional sales team through coaching, guidance, and performance management.
  • Represent ND Paper at customer meetings, industry events, and trade shows as needed.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Business, Marketing, Sales, or a related field.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Minimum of three (3) years of sales experience within the paper industry, including printing paper, folding boxboard, or containerboard.
  • Demonstrated success in sales growth, business development, customer relationship management, and account management.
  • Strong negotiation, communication, and presentation skills.
  • Proven ability to analyze market trends, develop sales strategies, and deliver results in a competitive market.
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, and capable of working independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office and CRM systems.

This position is compensated under a base salary plus commission structure.

title: Overseas Pre-sales Engineer-Brazil
description:
Responsibility：

Solution Development and Customization：

  • Communicate deeply with customers (commercial enterprises, industrial customers, agricultural cooperatives or government agencies) to evaluate their energy needs (such as cost reduction, renewable energy integration or grid stability).
  • Work with internal technical teams to design and propose customized solutions, such as 1 MW to 3 MW photovoltaic systems, battery backup (BESS) or hybrid energy projects.
  • Integrate photovoltaic, energy storage or other technologies according to the customer's specific application scenarios (such as peak shaving, off-grid power supply or frequency regulation services) to ensure the absorption and competitiveness of the solution.

Sales and Business Development：

  • Develop and implement solutions sales strategies to achieve company revenue targets, especially in the fast-growing distributed PV and energy storage market in Brazil.
  • Identify potential customers and sales opportunities, and proactively promote company products and services, such as solutions for the southeast region with high electricity prices or the northeast region with abundant solar resources.
  • Convert potential customers into actual orders by demonstrating technical advantages and return on investment (ROI).

Bridging technology and business

  • Explain the technical details of the solution to customers (such as PV system efficiency, energy storage discharge time) and translate them into business language (cost savings, revenue improvement).
  • Prepare and present professional sales proposals, including technical specifications, financial models (such as payback period calculation) and project benefit analysis.
  • Submit high-quality proposals on behalf of the company and participate in negotiations in bidding or competition (such as the 2025 energy storage auction).

Customer Relationship and After-Sales Support

  • Serve as the customer's primary contact to ensure smooth progress from solution design to project delivery, and provide technical consultation and support.
  • Follow up the progress of project implementation, coordinate with the engineering team, and solve problems that arise during installation or operation.
  • Provide after-sales service suggestions (such as system upgrades, maintenance plans) to promote long-term cooperation and upsell.

Market Analysis and Product Feedback

  • Monitor Brazilian energy market trends, such as policy changes (Law 14.300, ANEEL Energy Storage Specifications), competitor dynamics, and customer demand changes.
  • Collect customer feedback and work with product development teams to optimize solutions (such as increasing storage capacity or reducing costs).
  • Report market insights to management regularly and recommend new product or service directions.

Cross-departmental collaboration

  • Work closely with the technical team to ensure that the solution complies with Brazilian grid standards (such as ONS requirements) and customer expectations.
  • Coordinate with the finance department to provide financing options (such as BNDES loans or installments) to help customers overcome financial barriers.
  • Liaise with procurement and supply chain teams to ensure timely delivery of equipment (such as PV modules, batteries).

Training and knowledge sharing

  • Provide technical training to sales teams or customers to explain the working principles and advantages of photovoltaic and energy storage systems.
  • Participate in industry events (such as energy exhibitions) to showcase company solutions and build brand influence.

Requirement：

Preferred:

  • Direct experience in the field of photovoltaics or energy storage, such as selling 1 MW to 3 MW photovoltaic systems or battery energy storage solutions.
  • Participation in project development in the Brazilian market, such as distributed generation or grid integration projects.

title: Intake Coordinator
description:
Company Description Stronger Roots Housing is a community-focused organization dedicated to helping individuals and families access stable, safe, and affordable housing. The organization partners with local agencies, service providers, and community stakeholders to connect residents with resources that support long-term housing stability. Stronger Roots Housing emphasizes compassionate, client-centered services and clear communication to guide residents through complex housing processes. Team members work collaboratively to reduce barriers, improve access to support, and promote equitable housing opportunities. The organization values integrity, respect, and continuous improvement in serving the Lagoa Santa, MG community.

Role Description The Intake Coordinator is a full-time, hybrid role based in Lagoa Santa, MG, with some work-from-home flexibility. This role is responsible for greeting and engaging prospective clients, gathering initial information, and completing intake forms and assessments to determine eligibility for housing programs and related services. The Intake Coordinator will maintain accurate and confidential client records, verify documentation, and coordinate with case management staff to ensure smooth transitions from intake to ongoing support. Day-to-day tasks include answering phone calls and emails, providing clear information about available services, scheduling appointments, and following up with clients and partner organizations. The role also involves tracking referrals, supporting data entry for reporting, and collaborating with the broader team to improve intake processes and client experience.

Qualifications

  • Strong Communication skills, including clear verbal and written abilities to interact with clients and partners.
  • Customer Service skills to provide respectful, empathetic, and solution-oriented support to individuals and families.
  • Case Management-related skills, such as organizing client information, coordinating services, and managing follow-ups.
  • Familiarity with Medical Terminology and Insurance concepts, especially when working with clients who have health-related or coverage needs.
  • Relevant experience in housing services, social services, healthcare administration, or a similar client-facing environment.
  • Ability to handle confidential information, maintain accurate records, and use basic computer systems and databases.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple inquiries and tasks at once.
  • Preferred education: certificate or degree in Social Work, Human Services, Public Administration, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

title: Aeronautical Hydromechanical Systems Designer - Junior
description:
Summary Description

We are looking for a Junior Aeronautical Hydromechanical Systems Designer to work on the development and detailing of hydromechanical systems in civil and military aeronautical programs. The professionals will participate in system design and integration activities, working under the guidance of more experienced professionals and contributing to the development of technical solutions aligned with program requirements and aeronautical certification standards.

Key Responsibilities:

• Support the development of aeronautical hydromechanical installation projects in a 3D CAD environment;

• Prepare and review technical drawings and engineering documentation;

• Assist in the detailing of hydraulic, environmental (AMS/ECS), fuel, propulsion, and other onboard mechanical systems installations;

• Assist in the specification of aeronautical components, materials, and hardware;

• Prepare bills of materials (BOM) and technical project documentation;

• Support integration activities between hydromechanical systems, structures, electrical systems, and avionics;

• Participate in system integration and segregation analyses;

• Support manufacturing, assembly, and installation activities of systems;

• Assist in development testing, qualification, and certification activities;

• Participate in the analysis and implementation of technical requirements under the guidance of the team;

• Interact with multidisciplinary teams for the development of engineering solutions;

• Contribute to the preparation of technical documentation in accordance with internal processes and certification requirements.

Requirements

Education

• Technical course in Mechanics, Mechatronics, Electromechanics or related areas.

Desirable:

• Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aeronautical Engineering, Mechatronics or related areas (in progress or completed).

Experience

• Between 2 and 6 years of experience in mechanical design or aeronautical systems.

• Previous experience in an aeronautical environment will be considered a plus.

Technical knowledge

Hydromechanical Systems Project

• Basic design and detailing of aeronautical hydromechanical installations;

• Basic concepts of hydraulic systems;

• Basic concepts of environmental systems (AMS/ECS);

• Basic concepts of fuel systems;

• Basic concepts of propulsion systems;

• Reading and interpreting technical drawings;

• Basic concepts of aeronautical systems integration;

• Basic concepts of Bills of Materials (BOM).

Aeronautical Knowledge

• Basic concepts of the Aeronautical Product Development Process;

• Basic concepts of system integration and segregation;

• Basic concepts of aeronautical manufacturing and assembly;

• Good practices for installing aeronautical systems;

• Basic concepts of development, qualification, and certification testing;

• Basic knowledge of the aircraft certification process will be considered a plus.

Tools

Experience with tools such as:

• CATIA V5 / 3DEXPERIENCE;

• Microsoft Office.

5 – Desired skills

• Interest in learning and developing technically;

• Analytical thinking and problem-solving skills;

• Organization and planning;

• Good verbal and written communication;

• Multidisciplinary teamwork;

• Ease of interpersonal relationships;

• Proactivity and sense of responsibility;

• Commitment to quality, safety, and deadlines;

• Adaptability to work in a dynamic environment.

Differentials

Knowledge or experience in the following will be considered a plus:

• Aeronautical projects;

• Hydraulic, environmental (ECS/AMS), fuel, or propulsion systems;

• CATIA V5 or 3DEXPERIENCE;

• Aeronautical manufacturing processes;

• FAR/CS 23 or 25;

• DO-160;

• Technical English focused on aeronautical documentation.

Languages

• Intermediate English for reading and interpreting technical documentation. • Advanced English will be considered a plus.

Availability

• Domestic and international travel, when necessary.

• Working different shifts, as needed by the company.

5 – What do we expect

We are looking for professionals interested in building a career in the aeronautical industry, who are eager to learn, have a collaborative spirit, and are committed to technical excellence. We expect proactive, organized, and motivated individuals to develop high-quality engineering solutions, contributing to the success of programs and their professional growth within the Systems Engineering team.

title: Buyer
description:
About the Company

Tenneco is one of the world’s leading designers, manufacturers, and marketers of automotive products for original equipment and aftermarket customers, with approximately 65,000 team members working across more than 200 locations worldwide.

Through our four business groups — DRiV, Performance Solutions, Clean Air, and Powertrain — Tenneco is driving advancements in global mobility by delivering technology solutions to diverse markets, including light vehicles, commercial trucks, off-highway, industrial, motorsports, and aftermarket applications.

This position will be part of Tenneco’s Ride Performance business , within the Shock Absorbers division , based in Mogi Mirim, São Paulo, Brazil .

About the Role

The Buyer will be responsible for sourcing and developing productive materials for new product development projects across multiple commodities, including steel, stamped components, sintered parts, tubes, machined components, plastics, bearings, fasteners, rubber, chemicals, and others.

This role will be responsible for obtaining quotations and supporting the development and cost evaluation of new products, working closely with Quality and Engineering teams to develop new suppliers and products according to technical specifications. The position will also be responsible for negotiating commercial conditions and implementing commercial agreements and contracts.

Responsibilities

  • Request and analyze quotations in accordance with company policies from qualified and/or potential suppliers, ensuring compliance with technical specifications, quantities, delivery requirements, and project timelines.
  • Obtain quotations for productive materials to support the preparation and evaluation of the Bill of Materials (BOM) for new products.
  • Negotiate prices, payment terms, delivery conditions, and other commercial requirements with suppliers.
  • Conduct technical and commercial analysis of supplier proposals in collaboration with Quality and Product Engineering teams.
  • Lead the sourcing process and obtain the required internal approvals.
  • Select and nominate suppliers and coordinate the issuance and execution of commercial contracts.
  • Request and follow up on required PPAP documentation .
  • Follow up, when applicable, on quality testing, sample deliveries, and validation activities to ensure that materials and/or finished products meet project specifications and deadlines.
  • Analyze technical and financial proposals for new and existing components to achieve competitive sourcing results.
  • Negotiate competitive payment terms to optimize the company’s working capital.
  • Follow up on the issuance of Purchase Orders and, when applicable, monitor the process through material delivery to ensure internal stakeholders’ requirements are met.
  • Work closely with Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, and other cross-functional teams throughout the new product development and sourcing process.
  • Support cost competitiveness and supplier development initiatives aligned with business and project objectives.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, Materials Engineering, Automation and Control Engineering , or a related field.
  • Intermediate to Advanced English .
  • Advanced Excel skills.
  • Experience with SAP .
  • Knowledge of sourcing processes for new products and supplier development.
  • Experience in the automotive industry and/or with productive materials and commodities is highly desirable.
  • Strong negotiation, analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and manage multiple projects and priorities.

Required Skills

  • Negotiation skills.
  • Analytical skills.
  • Communication skills.
  • Problem-solving skills.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience in the automotive industry.
  • Knowledge of productive materials and commodities.

Salary Range & Compensation Package

We want you to feel welcomed, challenged, and inspired. That is why we have carefully designed a comprehensive benefits package focused on supporting your health and well-being, professional and personal growth, and integration into a positive and collaborative work environment.

title: Professor de educação física
description:
Job overview

We are looking for an experienced and qualified Physical Education teacher to join our Primary Section P.E Department at our Botafogo Site. We are seeking a dedicated educator to focus initially on teaching UK Key Stages 1 and 2, promoting sportsmanship, teamwork, and students’ overall well-being.

Responsibilities

  • Child Psychomotor Development: A deep understanding of body schemes, laterality, balance, and gross motor coordination for children aged 2 to 11 mainly.
  • International Curricula and Methodologies:
  • Familiarity with frameworks such as the EYFS (Early Years Foundation Stage) from the British curriculum
  • Familiarity in international curricula like the IPC (International Primary Curriculum) , Cambridge Primary / International Baccalaureate (IB).
  • Understanding the Transition from Early Years to Key Stage 1 / Primary
  • A child-centered and play-based learning approach through movement and active games.
  • Differentiation and Inclusion: Ability to design activity stations that accommodate different physical maturity levels.
  • Introduction to Basic Game Rules & Sports Literacy: Ability to teach simplified versions of team sports (mainly volleyball, basketball, futsal and handball), cooperative games, gymnastics, track & field (athletics), and rhythm and movement.
  • Spatial & Tactical Awareness: Teaching children how to share space, understand boundaries, play offense/defense in simple games, and follow rules safely.
  • First Aid & CPR: Practically mandatory in international schools to manage safety during physical activities with young children.
  • Child Protection & Safeguarding Training: A standard required certification across schools with British or American international curricula.
  • Energy, Patience, and Empathy: Ability to lead high-energy classes while maintaining a safe, welcoming, and dynamic environment.
  • Classroom Management in Open Spaces: Skill in keeping group attention and maintaining discipline through clear rules in gymnasiums or outdoors.
  • Intercultural Sensitivity: Ability to work effectively with families and students from diverse nationalities and cultural backgrounds.
  • Encouraging Sportsmanship & Teamwork: Guiding children through winning and losing gracefully, resolving minor conflict, and encouraging inclusive play.
  • Formal Progress Tracking & Reporting: Experience with assessing movement competency, tracking individual progress against curriculum standards, and writing formal student reports for parents.
  • Behavior Management: Ability to maintain structure and focus in larger spaces (gyms/fields) using clear routines, time-management techniques, and positive reinforcement for students.

Key Requirements

  • A degree and a teaching qualification in Physical Education (Licenciatura)
  • Active registration - CREF.
  • Fluency in English (C1 level)
  • The candidate must reside in Brazil.
  • Secure subject knowledge in Physical Education.
  • Proven ability to teach UK Key Stages 1 and 2 effectively.
  • Experience working in a school setting.

title: Segment Manager
description:
Position Details

Job Title: Segment Sales Manager — Short Range

Product Focus: Wi-Fi, Bluetooth/BLE & Short-Range Connectivity

Department: Sales — Latin America

Function: Segment Sales / Business Development

Reports To: Regional Sales Director, LATAM

Region: Latin America (LATAM)

Location: Brazil — supporting the LATAM region

Work Arrangement: (Hybrid / Remote)

Employment Type: Full-Time

Travel Required: Up to (40–50)% across the LATAM territory

Role Objective

Maximize Quectel’s LATAM market share and revenue for Short Range products by developing new customers and verticals, accelerating Wi-Fi/Bluetooth design wins, and enabling Regional Sales Managers to expand Short Range penetration within the existing customer base.

Primary Responsibilities

Market Growth & New Business

  • Own LATAM growth for Quectel Short Range products, with dedicated focus on customer acquisition, new verticals and market-share expansion.
  • Build and actively hunt a prioritized funnel of target accounts with clear next actions, opportunity value and design-win potential.
  • Identify cross-sell opportunities within the existing Quectel customer base and partner with RSMs to add Short Range solutions to active accounts.
  • Develop account strategies for customers designing connected products that require Wi-Fi, Bluetooth/BLE or other short-range wireless connectivity.

Customer & Design-Win Development

  • Understand customer applications, connectivity architecture, product requirements, qualification process and commercial expectations, and position the most relevant Short Range solution.
  • Track samples, technical evaluations, platform discussions, qualifications and design-in/design-win progress through the regional funnel.
  • Initiate and schedule roadmap meetings to identify future products and position Quectel early in the customer design cycle.
  • Maintain strong follow-up from first engagement through technical validation, commercial negotiation and conversion.

Sales Enablement & Channel Development

  • Train Regional Sales Managers, representative firms and distributors on the Short Range portfolio, target applications, competitive positioning and sales messages.
  • Support local sales teams with account strategy, opportunity qualification and customer-facing positioning for Wi-Fi/Bluetooth connectivity solutions.
  • Share use cases, competitive intelligence and market insights that help the wider sales organization recognize and win Short Range opportunities.

Product & Internal Collaboration

  • Work closely with Product Management and technical teams on customer requirements, product fit, roadmap needs, feature gaps and competitive positioning.
  • Translate customer and market feedback into actionable input for product planning, technical support and commercial strategy.
  • Coordinate internal resources to advance strategic Short Range opportunities through evaluation and decision stages.

CRM, Reporting & Market Intelligence

  • Maintain accurate and current account, opportunity and activity information in Salesforce CRM.
  • Prepare a monthly LATAM business review covering pipeline, leads, technical evaluations, customer meetings, roadmap discussions, risks and next steps.
  • Monitor market trends, competitors, target verticals and major customer programs relevant to Wi-Fi/Bluetooth and short-range connectivity growth.
  • Attend trade shows and industry events to identify connected products, target accounts and new Short Range opportunities, and capture qualified contacts for follow-up.

Qualifications & Experience

What we are looking for

  • (5)+ years of demonstrated success in B2B technical sales, business development or segment sales within Wi-Fi, Bluetooth/BLE, wireless modules/chipsets, semiconductors, IoT hardware or a closely related field.
  • Strong ability to prospect, build pipeline, develop new accounts and drive opportunities toward design wins and revenue.
  • Working understanding of embedded connectivity products, customer design cycles and the commercial/technical collaboration required to win component or module business.
  • Comfort discussing Wi-Fi, Bluetooth/BLE and short-range connectivity use cases with customers and internal technical teams.
  • Strong communication, presentation, negotiation and stakeholder-management skills across a multi-country sales region.
  • Hands-on CRM discipline and ability to produce clear funnel, activity and business-review reporting.
  • Fluent Portuguese and/or Spanish, plus professional working English.
  • Ability and willingness to travel across LATAM for customer meetings, partner development and industry events.

Preferred background

  • Experience selling Wi-Fi/Bluetooth modules, wireless chipsets, embedded connectivity solutions, IoT modules or related semiconductor products.
  • Existing relationships within LATAM IoT, industrial, smart-home, gateway/router, POS, consumer-device or other connected-product ecosystems.
  • Experience supporting distributors, representative firms or channel partners.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with Product Management, FAE and engineering teams on technical evaluations, platform requirements and customer design-ins.

What Success Looks Like

  • Growth in qualified Short Range pipeline and new target accounts.
  • Increase in Wi-Fi/Bluetooth design-ins/design wins and commercial conversions.
  • Higher Short Range penetration across existing Quectel accounts.
  • Strong RSM/channel enablement and opportunity follow-through.
  • Accurate Salesforce funnel management and monthly reporting.
  • Actionable market/competitive intelligence that improves sales execution.

Key Working Relationships

  • Regional Sales Managers (RSMs), local sales teams, representative firms and distributors.
  • Product Management, Technical/FAE teams and other internal stakeholders supporting customer design wins.
  • Customers, prospects, ecosystem partners and industry contacts across LATAM.

About Quectel

Quectel’s passion for a smarter world drives us to accelerate IoT innovation. We are an end-to-end global IoT solutions provider, and our team of more than 5,800 professionals delivers cellular, GNSS, satellite, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth modules, high-performance antennas, and full turnkey offerings including ODM services and system integration.

Founded in 2010 and headquartered in Shanghai, Quectel operates offices, R&D centers, and support teams across APAC, EMEA, North America, and LATAM. Our Short Range business combines a broad Wi-Fi and Bluetooth/BLE module portfolio with regional technical support, certification services, and design-in assistance.

Industries & Applications

Quectel’s Short Range portfolio powers connected products across:

  • Smart home and consumer devices
  • Gateways, routers, and CPE
  • Point of sale and retail terminals
  • Industrial IoT and automation
  • Smart metering and utilities
  • Asset tracking and telematics
  • Healthcare and wearable devices

Why Quectel LATAM?

  • Global Impact, Regional Focus — Own a product line across Latin America, backed by a global organization with teams in APAC, EMEA, and North America.
  • Career Growth — Mentorship, international exposure, internal mobility, and clear advancement paths.
  • Cutting-Edge Technology — Next-generation Wi-Fi, Bluetooth/BLE, and embedded connectivity solutions in mission-critical applications.
  • Inclusive, Global Team — A multicultural workplace collaborating with IoT experts across engineering, sales, and operations.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive base salary benchmarked to the local market
  • Uncapped sales commission tied to Short Range revenue and design wins in your territory
  • Meal and grocery vouchers
  • Private health insurance with no co-pay, extendable to dependents
  • Dental coverage
  • Life insurance and accident cover
  • Paid time off plus statutory holidays, and paid parental leave per local law
  • International exposure — HQ visits and global trade shows such as CES, Embedded World, and MWC
  • Structured onboarding and ongoing product training, with internal mobility across a global organization

Learn More

Explore products, careers, and news at , or follow Quectel Wireless Solutions on LinkedIn.

Note: Responsibilities may evolve based on business priorities and market needs.

title: Especialista de Portfólio de Crédito
description:
Aqui, as coisas acontecem de verdade! Somos a Studio Z Ouze, uma única empresa que reúne duas marcas que estão entre as maiores do Brasil no varejo de calçados e no mercado financeiro. São mais de 100 lojas em 16 estados, um time de mais de 2 mil pessoas e um só objetivo: entregar moda e crédito acessíveis, com qualidade e agilidade.

Oferecemos o que nossos clientes precisam, sempre com inovação, energia e foco em resultados. Foi assim que começamos há 50 anos e é isso que seguimos fazendo todos os dias.

Buscamos um profissional para atuar como referência técnica na análise e na gestão do portfólio de crédito (Cartão e Empréstimo Pessoal), produzindo estudos, análises e reportes que sustentem a performance da carteira ao longo de todo o ciclo de crédito. Assegurar o equilíbrio entre crescimento, risco e rentabilidade, a maximização da recuperação de crédito e a plena aderência às normas regulatórias — em especial a Res. CMN 4.966/2021 — e ao Código de Defesa do Consumidor.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

1. Realizar o monitoramento contínuo dos indicadores de risco do portfólio (inadimplência, roll rates, perda líquida, comportamento de safras e eficiência de cobrança), por meio da consolidação e análise de dados, para subsidiar decisões e planos de ação da área.

2. Elaborar análises e apresentações executivas sobre a performance da carteira, forecast de perdas e simulação de cenários, garantindo qualidade, consistência e clareza das informações reportadas a comitês e à gestão.

3. Apoiar a aderência regulatória da carteira junto ao Banco Central, contribuindo para reportes regulatórios (CADOCs, SCR), planos de remediação e respostas a inspeções e demandas do regulador.

4. Acompanhar e analisar provisões e perdas (PDD, write-off e recuperação de crédito) conforme as normas contábeis e regulatórias vigentes (Res. CMN 4.966/2021), validando premissas e avaliando impactos no resultado.

5. Elaborar consultas e extrações em SQL sobre as bases de dados da companhia, estruturando e validando as informações de carteira, inadimplência e perdas que sustentam as análises e os reportes da área.

6. Desenvolver estudos analíticos em Excel e automações em Python (ou ferramenta similar) para tratamento de dados, simulação de cenários e apoio à tomada de decisão, garantindo agilidade e confiabilidade das análises.

7. Propor e implementar melhorias e padronização de processos, bases e controles da área, fortalecendo a eficiência, a governança de dados e a confiabilidade das análises.

8. Prover suporte técnico e disseminar boas práticas analíticas e de gestão de portfólio junto aos demais membros da equipe, contribuindo como referência técnica para o time.

9. Cumprir e apoiar o cumprimento das políticas corporativas, normas, procedimentos de saúde e segurança do trabalho e diretrizes de compliance da companhia, atuando em conformidade com os princípios éticos e regulatórios, visando garantir integridade dos processos e mitigação de riscos organizacionais.

Requisitos e qualificações:

Escolaridade: Superior Completo (Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Estatística, Ciências Contábeis, Ciência de Dados ou áreas correlatas). Pós-graduação desejável.

Tempo de Experiência mínima: Acima de 4 anos em gestão de portfólio de crédito, risco, cobrança ou áreas analíticas de instituições financeiras.

Conhecimento avançado em Excel, Python e SQL.

title: Cloud Architect
description:
Position: Azure Cloud Architect

Location: Remote - Brazil (EST time zone)

Contract: 6 month+ extensions

This is a remote role, with a preference for candidates based in the U.S. Eastern Time zone.

You’ll architect, design, build, and troubleshoot cloud solutions across a hybrid cloud platform, partnering with our Global Infrastructure, Security, Network, Enterprise, Application, and Data teams to ensure everything we ship is secure, compliant, and aligned with company standards and our global cloud strategy.

Day to day, you will:

  • Lead application modernization — re-platform and refactor workloads from IaaS to PaaS to improve scalability, cost efficiency, and maintainability.
  • Serve as Level 3 (L3) escalation for complex infrastructure issues, driving deep root-cause analysis and resolving problems that lower support tiers can’t.
  • Design secure-by-default architectures — embed zero-trust principles, defense-in-depth, identity and access management, network segmentation, and data protection into every solution from the start.
  • Partner with Security Architects on threat modeling and design reviews and ensure solutions meet Sodexo security standards and relevant compliance requirements.
  • Assess the technical impact of new solutions and how they integrate into the existing ecosystem, including impact assessments for new projects and technologies.
  • Design technical architectures with a clear focus on user experience, scalability, standardization, cost, and security.
  • Build cost-optimized designs — right-size resources, select the most cost-effective service tiers and pricing models (reserved capacity, autoscaling, PaaS consumption), and apply FinOps practices so solutions stay efficient as they scale.
  • Scope multiple concurrent projects accurately and deliver on time.
  • Identify process and knowledge gaps and work across teams to close them.
  • Map business and technology dependencies and collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver solutions quickly.
  • Produce technical documentation and architecture diagrams.
  • Recommend solutions grounded in Sodexo Global Standards to keep consistency through this period of change.
  • Advise on how and where Cloud Platforms can be used across the Sodexo ecosystem and guide architectural choices in line with global standards.
  • Deliver end-to-end cloud infrastructure architectures and designs using modern capabilities such as PaaS.
  • Partner with architects across other disciplines (Enterprise, Data, Security, Network, Application) and engage the broader Cloud Competency Center community across regions.
  • Manage partner relationships and coordinate development efforts across multiple teams.
  • Champion the architectural standards set by the Global Cloud Competency Center and ensure alignment with global Enterprise Architecture principles.

Required

  • Azure architecture expertise — proven ability to design and implement cloud infrastructure, platforms, and applications.
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305) or equivalent.
  • 5+ years in an Azure architecture role spanning IaaS, PaaS, and integrations.
  • 10+ years overall in cloud and IT infrastructure architecture.
  • Hands-on experience modernizing applications from IaaS to PaaS — re-platforming and refactoring workloads onto managed Azure services.
  • Experience with Azure AI services and assets — e.g., Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI Search, and Cognitive Services — including how to architect, integrate, and secure them within the enterprise landing zone.
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues such as L3 escalation, including root-cause analysis through resolution.
  • Strong grasp of cloud security architecture: identity and access management (Microsoft Entra ID / RBAC), network security (segmentation, NSGs, private endpoints, firewalls), encryption at rest and in transit, key management, tenant isolation, vulnerability management, and SIEM.
  • Hands-on with Azure-native security and governance tooling — Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, Key Vault, Azure Policy — and secure landing zone design.
  • Hands-on background administering Windows Server, Linux, and the Azure Portal.
  • Cloud cost optimization / FinOps experience — cost modeling, right-sizing, resource tagging and governance, and using Azure Cost Management to track, forecast, and reduce spend.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps in a Scrum or Agile environment.
  • Solid understanding across cloud and infrastructure components — servers, virtualization, storage, network, data, and applications — to deliver true end-to-end designs.
  • Solid understanding of operating systems and networking. Experience in Window and Linux OS.

How you work

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • A strong problem-solver — you analyze issues clearly, communicate well with colleagues, and drive to quick, sound conclusions.
  • Adaptable and curious — comfortable picking up new technologies quickly.

title: Especialista em Custos
description:
Sobre a Empresa

Somos uma empresa global do setor automotivo, pertencente ao grupo alemão Eberspächer , especializada no desenvolvimento e fabricação de sistemas de exaustão e soluções acústicas para veículos leves, comerciais e off-road.

Com forte presença internacional e milhares de colaboradores ao redor do mundo, atuamos diretamente na criação de tecnologias que reduzem emissões e ruídos, atendendo aos mais rigorosos padrões ambientais e de qualidade exigidos pela indústria global.

Por que trabalhar conosco?

Nos destacamos pelo compromisso com a inovação, a sustentabilidade e, acima de tudo, o desenvolvimento de pessoas. Promovemos um ambiente colaborativo baseado em confiança, respeito e incentivo contínuo ao crescimento profissional. Vem construir o futuro da mobilidade com a gente!

Desafio da Posição (Responsabilidades):

  • Analisar criticamente RFQs, desenhos técnicos e premissas de volume e processo produtivo;
  • Construir o cost breakdown completo, detalhando materiais, mão de obra, máquinas e overhead;
  • Estimar custos de matéria-prima, componentes e perdas produtivas (scrap);
  • Definir roteiro produtivo e calcular tempos de ciclo e capacidade;
  • Estimar investimentos (CAPEX) e amortização de ferramentas e equipamentos;
  • Apoiar a formação de preço de venda, garantindo as margens de rentabilidade e a competitividade do negócio;
  • Elaborar o business case dos projetos (mensurando P&L, payback, break-even e IRR);
  • Identificar oportunidades de engenharia de valor e redução de custo (VA/VE);
  • Atualizar e acompanhar as estimativas de custos durante as fases de desenvolvimento e industrialização (APQP);
  • Realizar o comparativo entre o custo estimado versus o real e suportar ativamente iniciativas de cost-down.

O que buscamos (Requisitos e Qualificações):

  • Ensino Superior completo em Engenharia, Administração, Economia, Ciências Contábeis ou áreas correlatas;
  • Sólida experiência e conhecimento consolidado na área de Custos Industriais, Estimativa de Custos (Cost Estimating) e Controladoria;
  • Vivência prática na análise de RFQs e interpretação técnica de desenhos industriais e processos de manufatura;
  • Inglês Avançado (indispensável para o contato com premissas e times globais);
  • Perfil com forte raciocínio lógico, excelente comunicação e visão analítica.

O que oferecemos (Benefícios, Cuidado e Bem-estar):

  • Alimentação de qualidade: Restaurante interno com opções de café da manhã, almoço e jantar;

  • Desenvolvimento: Parcerias e descontos exclusivos com diversas instituições de ensino.

Vaga efetiva, com oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento e crescimento profissional.

♿ Nossas oportunidades são inclusivas! Esta vaga está aberta a pessoas com e sem deficiência (PcD).

title: Banco de Talentos | Inclusão de Pessoas com Deficiência (Consórcio UHN - RNEST)
description:
O Consórcio UHN, formado pela Odebrecht Engenharia & Construção e pela Tenenge, subsidiárias do Grupo Novonor , foi criado para execução construção da Unidade de Hidrotratamento de Nafta (UHDT-N), parte do projeto do Trem 2 da Refinaria Abreu e Lima (RNEST), localizada em Ipojuca/PE.

A Odebrecht Engenharia & Construção e pela Tenenge atuam sob o propósito é contribuir para a construção de um futuro sustentável, servindo à sociedade por meio da capacidade transformadora de nossa Engenharia. Todos os dias, buscamos fornecer soluções para alguns dos maiores desafios do mundo - como educação, saúde, energia, água, transporte, habitação e saneamento.

Consócio UHN (Odebrecht e Tenenge) & Inclusão de Pessoas com Deficiência:

Acreditamos que a pluralidade e o conhecimento técnico potencializam a nossa força, aprimoram as nossas entregas e impactam nos resultados.

Para nós, a inclusão de Pessoas com Deficiência no ambiente empresarial presume uma postura ativa pela garantia de direitos humanos, com respeito e valorização das diferenças em todas as suas dimensões, reconhecendo também a multiplicidade humana, em todas as suas formas, como fator de inovação, produtividade e performance.

Assim, buscamos o fortalecimento de uma conduta inclusiva regida por uma Cultura Empresarial pautada em valores humanistas e que favorece a colaboração e a criatividade, além de reforçarmos o posicionamento de promotores da Diversidade e da Inclusão em nosso ambiente.

Almejamos construir um ambiente mais inclusivo e acolhedor para pessoas com deficiência, proporcionando condições equânimes para todos. Para tanto, fomentar a representação de pessoas com deficiência na empresa é um dever compartilhado por todas as nossas lideranças nas diversas operações da companhia.

O quadro de Integrantes do Consócio UHN é diverso, composto por profissionais de diferentes regiões, gerações, graus de escolaridade e áreas de atuação. Sendo assim, pessoas com deficiência residentes em Ipojuca/PE e adjacências, e de todo o Brasil, podem se candidatar neste banco de talentos.

title: Analista Financeiro Jr.
description:
OBJETIVO DO CARGO

Responsável pela gestão financeira e operacional das carteiras de resseguro automático (proporcionais e não proporcionais), atuando desde o processamento até a conciliação bancária, reportes internos e relacionamento com resseguradoras e cedentes. O profissional garantirá o correto fluxo de prêmios, sinistros, comissões e ajustes no sistema da corretora, assegurando conformidade regulatória junto à SUSEP e integridade dos dados financeiros.

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES

1. Operações Financeiras e Processamento de Borderôs

  • Fechamento de câmbio para transferências enviadas ou recebidas de resseguradoras internacionais.

2. Conciliação Bancária e Controles Financeiros

  • Conciliação bancária periódica das contas vinculadas às operações de resseguro automático.
  • Identificação e regularização de diferenças entre extratos bancários e registros sistêmicos.
  • Controle de posição financeira por contrato: saldo a pagar, saldo a receber, inadimplência e aging.
  • Desejável gestão de câmbio: acompanhamento de conversão de moedas, taxas de fechamento e registro contábil das variações cambiais.
  • Desejável saber fazer monitoramento e controle de remessas ao exterior, com suporte à área de câmbio e compliance.

3. Atualização e Manutenção de Sistemas

  • Lançamento, atualização e manutenção de dados financeiros no sistema operacional da companhia.
  • Validação de integridade de dados após cada ciclo de processamento (prêmios, sinistros, comissões).
  • Apoio na implementação e testes de novas funcionalidades do sistema relacionadas a contratos automáticos.

4. Relacionamento com Resseguradoras

  • Envio de comprovantes periódicos às Resseguradoras.
  • Negociação e resolução de divergências/dúvidas.
  • Acompanhamento de prazos de pagamento e recebimento conforme acordado nos contratos e exigências da SUSEP.
  • Suporte ao processo de renovação dos contratos com informações financeiras e histórico de pagamentos.

6. Compliance , Regulatório e Reportes

  • Garantia de conformidade das operações com as normas regulatórias.
  • Suporte ao fechamento contábil mensal: Conferência e fornecimento de informações financeiras para o time de contabilidade Brasil, América Latina e Londres.
  • Apoio na preparação de informações para auditorias internas e externas

REQUISITOS

Formação Acadêmica

  • Superior Cursando em Economia, Contabilidade, Finanças, Administração ou áreas correlatas

Conhecimentos Técnicos

  • Excel avançado: tabelas dinâmicas
  • Desejável noções de câmbio e operações em moeda estrangeira

  • Alta atenção a detalhes e rigor na verificação de dados
  • Capacidade analítica e raciocínio quantitativo
  • Proatividade na identificação e resolução de divergências

Idiomas
